page.layout: One page of text, centred. A woodcut engraving (tree with banner, figure, owl) sits in the middle below the lines. Imprint centred at the foot. A library stamp at right is not transcribed.

l.i: Quid de hisce CARTESIUS, ejusque sequaces, boni aut secus senserint,
omnisque PHILOSOPHIÆ certiora fundamenta, atque in primis

page.notes: Woodcut between the title and the imprint: a tree with a banner bearing a motto across its trunk (the banner text is too small and worn to read; it is marked illegible above), a figure standing at the right, an owl and a serpent at the left, on a grassy base. Not transcribed as text. The line "Apud DANIELEM ELSEVIRIUM," and the date were read from the scan; the date is printed as cIↄ IↄC LXXVII, given as MDCLXXVII. Excluded: the library stamp "KONINKL. BIBLIOTHEEK TEShAGE" at right, the pencilled shelf mark at top right, and the digitiser's credit line at the foot.
